records.observation: Constructor Object only. Tolerance default squared10, setter performs int tolerance*tolerance+1 before converting double, overflow unchecked. draw receives left/top, right/bottom and center/stem-origin coordinates. Converts center time first, tests DrawnBox.coversEvent and records only center x BEFORE visibility test; requires strict0<centerX<imageWidth, excludes boundary x0/width and suppresses whole shape if center outside even when wings could intersect. Converts remaining time/row coordinates without ordering or validity checks. If topY!=stemY fills two colored half ellipses with shared height stemY-topY-1: left origin leftX,width2*(centerX-leftX),angle90/sweep180; right origin2*centerX-rightX,width2*(rightX-centerX),angle90/sweep-180. Draws white stem centerX,stemY-to-bottomY then white half-ellipse outlines when top differs from stem. No range/overflow/negative dimensions checks or explicit wing clipping. Optional stroke saved/restored only normal path; color left white. containsPixel first enforces inclusive original left/right/top/bottom bounding rectangle, so tolerance cannot select outside these bounds; no DrawnBox/viewport consideration. Then distance to center stem segment strictly less than squared tolerance accepts. If top!=stem and stem-distance fails, chooses left vs right half by pointX<centerX, uses ellipse radii centerX-leftX or rightX-centerX and (stemY-topY)/2 WITHOUT drawing minus1 height. isInEllipse computes ((pointX-originX)/rx-1)^2+((pointY-originY)/ry-1)^2<=1 using dcmpg; zero radii/NaN have no explicit guard, NaN comparison rejects. Geometry can therefore differ by a pixel from raster dimensions. Equal top/stem has line test only. No sorted coordinates or finite checks; graphics clip and actual appearance remain runtime concerns, not established by static reading.
